name: Wise Crowds
deliverable: Scaled peer advisory council consulting for individual challenge clients

steps.text: Seat one client before a circle; the client describes the challenge and what they have tried.
Advisors ask clarifying questions, then discuss the problem with each other while the client listens.
Have the client name what landed; then rotate.

failure: Advisors slip into asking the client what to do, and the circle becomes an ordinary meeting.
intervention: Tell the advisors to talk to each other; the client only writes until their final turn comes.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.title: The Surprising Power of Liberating Structures
